core_obligations: Choose the etale scheme chart and lift the point to the fibre product.
Verify the pointed hypothesis required by the parent splitting lemma.
Conclude the decomposition with the finite piece carrying the lifted point.

proof_roadmap.step: Application of the parent splitting lemma.

difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y separated locally of finite type between algebraic spaces over S, and x over y, if f is quasi-finite at x the lemma produces an etale morphism of pointed spaces (U, u) -> (Y, y) and an open-and-closed decomposition U x_Y X = W coproduct V with V -> U finite and V containing a point mapping to x (and u). The retained proof is written: pick a scheme U etale over Y with u over y (charts exist by definition of algebraic space); the cartesian-points lemma (Properties of Spaces, lemma points-cartesian) supplies x' in |U x_Y X| over (x, u); apply the already-collected splitting lemma etale-splits-off-quasi-finite-part to U x_Y X -> U at x', noting its pointedness hypothesis is satisfied because U is a scheme so u comes from Spec kappa(u) -> U. Retained author proof at lines 7563-7572.
